title: Hands Up
style: rap, driving, energetic, female vocals, clean, rhythmic, fake, minimal, rapid, vocal, bassline, strong, gradual, female vocals, electronica, hands up, low
lyrics:
[Intro]
[whispered vocals]
Hands up
Wanna quit then?

[Verse 1]
You think you're done, you're pulling back
White flag up, that's not your track
I saw you move, I saw you try
But fear got cold inside your eye
Hands up high, don't drop 'em now
Say what you came, don't act like wow
You wanna quit? Then quit right
Show me that fire, show me grit

[Pre-Drop]
Quit then
Quit then
Quit then
Quit then
[Drop]
[aggressive vocals]
Hands up (Wanna quit then?)
Hands up (Wanna quit then?)
[heavy electronica]
[driving bass]
[synth riff]
[Verse 2]
You had the spark, you had the flame
Now you're talking 'bout giving in, same
I don't follow weak declared
Stand up strong or get out aired
No white flags, no surrender
This ain't time for you to end her
(End it, finish, close the door)
Fight it out, show what you bore

[Pre-Drop]
Quit then
Quit then
Quit then
Quit then
Harder now
Harder now
[Drop]
Hands up (Wanna quit then?)
Hands up (Wanna quit then?)
Not today (Quit then?)
Not today (Quit then?)
[trap break]

[Bridge]
If you're leaving, leave it clean
No half-move, no fake scene
But if you're staying, stay all in
Burn it hot, let demons sin
[whispered vocals]
So what's it gonna be?
Quit then?
Or fight through?
What's it gonna be?
[Final Drop]
Hands up
Hands up
Hands up (Wanna quit then?)
